directives.intent: Convert the accumulated Former and terraforming capacity into expansion now: choose a Colony Pod whenever it is a legal production option until base count rises; choose a facility or another Former only when no Colony Pod is available.
directives.rationale: The v2 arm built 116 Formers but stayed at six bases through turn 140 because its co-equal capacity directive remained active and selected zero Colony Pods. This arm isolates the missing phase handoff from capacity construction to expansion production.
